whys.why: Why was the headline 'NIGHT MARKET' not met?
whys.because: No poster file exists, so the grader had no rendered headline to check.
whys.evidence: s2r.old.dumper.J50c/grade.json: check 'something was made' pass=false, got 'no file'. Headline reason: 'No image exists, so no text was rendered; it was only stated in the plan.' The happy chat's reason is the same: 'No poster exists'.

whys.because: The server refused both generate_image calls (turn 1 orange, turn 2 navy), so the chat produced no output.
whys.evidence: s2r.old.happy.J50c/calls.jsonl lines 2 and 7: approve=false, reason 'insufficient credits: this call needs about 10 credits and 0 remain on the account', then 'needs about 5 credits and 0 remain'. The dumper calls.jsonl shows the same two refusals.

whys.why: Why were the calls refused? Was it the assistant's fault?
whys.because: No. The assistant sent valid, well-formed requests. The prompts held the exact text 'NIGHT MARKET' / 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM', and it even fell back to the cheapest model (flux-2-klein, 5 credits). The only cause of refusal was the credit balance.
whys.evidence: calls.jsonl args: model qwen-image-2.1 and then flux-2-klein, resolution 640px, prompts quote both text lines exactly. The refusal reason names credits only, not the arguments.

whys.why: Why did the account have 0 credits at the start of the chat?
whys.because: The old-build chats ran live against the hosted server on a shared free-plan account. Earlier chats in the fleet had already used up all its credits. The very first call of each chat already saw 0 remaining.
whys.evidence: chat.json: mode 'live', url 'https://mcp.magichour.ai/', side 'old'. The first call in both chats (line 2, first tool call of the chat) reports '0 remain on the account'. The symptom hits only the old build (3/3 old, any persona), so persona and conversation do not matter.

whys.why: Why is this the end of the chain?
whys.because: The test harness ran the old-build chats on an account with no credits left. Nothing in the tool descriptions, the brief or the assistant's behaviour could make a poster with 0 credits. This is a harness defect: the run did not reset credits or check them before each chat.
whys.evidence: All three failing chats are old-build, across happy, dumper and stupid personas. Each failed at the first call with 0 credits. The assistant replied honestly with 'cannot' in both turns (calls.jsonl say entries).

result.axiom: The shared free-plan account used by the old (hosted, live) build had 0 credits before the J50c chats began. Every generate_image call was refused, so no poster, and no headline, could exist. This is a harness artifact (credit exhaustion across the fleet run), not a tool, model or assistant defect.
result.fix: In the bench harness, check the account credit balance before each live chat and top it up or reset it. Use a fresh or refilled free-plan account per chat or per batch. If credits are below the cost of the cheapest test run, mark the chat as 'harness: no credits' and exclude it from grading, so it is not scored as a must-have failure.
